column2:
lad(n.)少年、小伙子
(無詞性變化)
a young lad 年輕小伙子
the lads 哥兒們
The old fisherman taught the young lad how to tie strong knots.
(老漁夫教那個年輕小伙子如何打牢固的結。)
He has been a hardworking lad since he was a child.
(他從小就是個勤奮的孩子。)

landlady(n.)女房東、(旅館等的)女老闆
landlord(n.)房東
friendly landlady 和善的女房東
pay rent to the landlady 付房租給女房東
Our landlady lives downstairs and often brings us homemade cookies.
(我們的女房東住在樓下，常常拿自製餅乾給我們。)
I have to pay the rent to my landlady by the fifth of each month.
(我每個月五號前必須付房租給女房東。)

landslide(n.)山崩、土石流、(選舉)壓倒性勝利
(無詞性變化)
landslide victory 壓倒性勝利
cause a landslide 引起山崩
Heavy rain from the typhoon caused a landslide that blocked the mountain road.
(颱風帶來的豪雨引發山崩，阻斷了山路。)
The candidate won the election by a landslide.
(那位候選人以壓倒性勝利贏得選舉。)

latitude(n.)緯度、(行動等的)自由
latitudinal(adj.)緯度的
high latitudes 高緯度地區
latitude and longitude 經緯度
The Tropic of Cancer passes through Chiayi at a latitude of about 23.5 degrees north.
(北回歸線在北緯約23.5度處穿過嘉義。)
Our teacher gives us a lot of latitude in choosing research topics.
(老師給我們很大的自由選擇研究題目。)

lavish(adj.)奢華的、慷慨的、過分大方的
lavishly(adv.)奢華地、慷慨地
lavish lifestyle 奢華的生活方式
lavish praise 大力讚揚
The movie star threw a lavish party at a five-star hotel.
(那位電影明星在五星級飯店舉辦了一場奢華的派對。)
The coach was lavish in his praise of the young players.
(教練對年輕球員讚不絕口。)

layman(n.)外行人、門外漢、普通信徒
layperson(n.)外行人(中性用法)
in layman's terms 用淺顯易懂的話來說
to the layman 對外行人來說
Can you explain the theory in layman's terms?
(你能用淺顯易懂的話解釋這個理論嗎？)
To the layman, these legal documents are very hard to understand.
(對外行人來說，這些法律文件非常難懂。)

layout(n.)布局、版面設計、格局
lay out(v.)安排、規劃
page layout 版面設計
floor layout 平面格局
I love the open layout of this apartment.
(我很喜歡這間公寓的開放式格局。)
The designer changed the layout of the magazine's front page.
(設計師改變了雜誌封面的版面配置。)

lease(n.)租約、租賃契約
leaseholder(n.)承租人
sign a lease 簽租約
a one-year lease 一年的租約
We signed a two-year lease on the apartment near the university.
(我們簽下了大學附近那間公寓的兩年租約。)
When the lease expires, the landlord may raise the rent.
(租約到期時，房東可能會漲房租。)

legislator(n.)立法委員、立法者
legislate(v.)立法
legislation(n.)法律、立法
elect a legislator 選出立法委員
state legislator 州議員
Several legislators proposed a new law to protect stray animals.
(幾位立法委員提出一項保護流浪動物的新法案。)
The legislator promised to improve public transportation in his district.
(那位立法委員承諾改善他選區的大眾運輸。)

lengthy(adj.)冗長的、漫長的
length(n.)長度
lengthen(v.)加長、延長
lengthy discussion 冗長的討論
lengthy process 漫長的過程
After a lengthy discussion, the committee finally reached an agreement.
(經過冗長的討論，委員會終於達成協議。)
Applying for a visa can be a lengthy process.
(申請簽證可能是個漫長的過程。)

lesbian(adj.)女同性戀的、女同性戀者
(無詞性變化)
lesbian couple 女同性戀伴侶
gay and lesbian rights 同志權益
The novel tells the story of a lesbian couple fighting for the right to marry.
(這本小說講述一對女同志伴侶爭取婚姻權利的故事。)
Taiwan became the first place in Asia where gay and lesbian couples could legally marry.
(臺灣成為亞洲第一個同性伴侶可以合法結婚的地方。)

lessen(v.)減少、減輕
less(adj./adv.)較少的、較少地
lessen the impact 減輕衝擊
lessen the pain 減輕疼痛
Planting more trees can lessen the effects of air pollution.
(多種樹可以減輕空氣汙染的影響。)
The doctor gave him medicine to lessen the pain.
(醫生給他藥來減輕疼痛。)

lethal(adj.)致命的、致死的
lethally(adv.)致命地
lethal dose 致死劑量
lethal weapon 致命武器
Mixing these two chemicals can produce a lethal gas.
(混合這兩種化學物質可能產生致命氣體。)
Drunk driving can be lethal to both drivers and pedestrians.
(酒駕對駕駛人和行人都可能是致命的。)

liable(adj.)有法律責任的、易於⋯的
liability(n.)責任、負債
be liable for 對⋯負有法律責任
be liable to 易於⋯、很可能⋯
Parents may be liable for damage caused by their children.
(父母可能要對孩子造成的損害負法律責任。)
This old bridge is liable to collapse in a strong earthquake.
(這座老橋在強烈地震中很可能會倒塌。)

liberate(v.)解放、使獲得自由
liberation(n.)解放
liberal(adj.)開明的、自由主義的
liberated(adj.)獲得解放的
liberate from 使從⋯中解放
liberate a city 解放城市
The soldiers liberated the prisoners from the camp.
(士兵們把囚犯從營中解放出來。)
Technology can liberate people from boring and repetitive work.
(科技能讓人們從無聊重複的工作中解放出來。)

liberation(n.)解放、解放運動
liberate(v.)解放
women's liberation 婦女解放運動
national liberation 民族解放
The women's liberation movement fought for equal rights in the 1960s.
(婦女解放運動在1960年代爭取平等權利。)
Quitting the stressful job gave her a sense of liberation.
(辭掉那份壓力大的工作讓她有種解脫的感覺。)

lieutenant(n.)中尉、副手、副職官員
(無詞性變化)
second lieutenant 少尉
lieutenant governor 副州長
After graduating from the military academy, he became a second lieutenant.
(他從軍校畢業後成為一名少尉。)
The general trusted his lieutenant to lead the troops.
(將軍信任他的副手來率領部隊。)

lifelong(adj.)終身的、畢生的
(無詞性變化)
lifelong learning 終身學習
lifelong friend 一輩子的朋友
Lifelong learning is essential in today's fast-changing world.
(在當今快速變遷的世界中，終身學習是不可或缺的。)
She and I have been lifelong friends since kindergarten.
(她和我從幼稚園起就是一輩子的好朋友。)

lighten(v.)減輕、使變亮、使輕鬆
light(adj./n.)輕的、光
lighten the load 減輕負擔
lighten up 放輕鬆
Robots can lighten the workload of nurses in hospitals.
(機器人可以減輕醫院護理師的工作量。)
Lighten up! It's just a game, not a matter of life and death.
(放輕鬆！這只是遊戲，又不是生死攸關的事。)

limp(n./v.)跛行、一跛一跛地走
limply(adv.)無力地
walk with a limp 跛著腳走路
limp off the field 跛著腳離場
The player limped off the field after hurting his ankle.
(那名球員扭傷腳踝後一跛一跛地離開球場。)
Ever since the accident, he has walked with a slight limp.
(自從那次意外後，他走路就有點跛。)

liner(n.)郵輪、客輪、襯墊、眼線筆
line(n./v.)線、排隊、襯裡
ocean liner 遠洋客輪
trash can liner 垃圾袋
The ocean liner carried over two thousand passengers across the Atlantic.
(那艘遠洋客輪載著兩千多名乘客橫渡大西洋。)
Put a plastic liner in the trash can before you throw away food waste.
(丟廚餘之前先在垃圾桶裡套上塑膠袋。)

linger(v.)逗留、徘徊、持續存在
lingering(adj.)揮之不去的、拖延的
linger on 持續存在、繼續逗留
linger in the air 瀰漫不散(氣味等)
The smell of fried food lingered in the kitchen for hours.
(炸物的味道在廚房裡久久不散。)
Fans lingered outside the stadium long after the concert ended.
(演唱會結束許久後，歌迷仍在體育場外逗留。)

lining(n.)襯裡、內襯、內層
line(v.)加襯裡
silver lining 一線希望
stomach lining 胃壁
Every cloud has a silver lining.
(每片烏雲都鑲著銀邊；黑暗中總有一線希望。)
The coat has a warm wool lining for the winter.
(這件大衣有保暖的羊毛內襯，適合冬天穿。)

liter(n.)公升
(無詞性變化)
a liter of 一公升的⋯
liters per minute 每分鐘幾公升
Adults should drink about two liters of water a day.
(成年人一天應該喝大約兩公升的水。)
This car uses about six liters of gas per hundred kilometers.
(這輛車每一百公里大約耗油六公升。)

literacy(n.)讀寫能力、識字、(某領域的)素養
literate(adj.)識字的
illiteracy(n.)文盲、不識字
literacy rate 識字率
media literacy 媒體素養
Taiwan has a literacy rate of nearly one hundred percent.
(臺灣的識字率幾乎達到百分之百。)
Media literacy helps students tell real news from fake news.
(媒體素養幫助學生分辨真假新聞。)

literal(adj.)字面上的、逐字的、照字面的
literally(adv.)照字面地、簡直
literal meaning 字面意義
literal translation 直譯
The literal meaning of the idiom is quite different from its real meaning.
(這個成語的字面意思和它真正的意思相差很大。)
I was literally shaking with fear during the horror movie.
(看恐怖片時我簡直怕到發抖。)

literate(adj./n.)識字的、有讀寫能力的、有學問的人
literacy(n.)讀寫能力
illiterate(adj.)不識字的
computer literate 懂電腦的
highly literate 學識淵博的
In today's job market, almost every employee needs to be computer literate.
(在現今的就業市場，幾乎每位員工都需要懂電腦。)
Only a small number of people were literate in ancient times.
(在古代只有少數人識字。)

livestock(n.)家畜、牲畜
(無詞性變化)
raise livestock 飼養家畜
livestock farming 畜牧業
Many farmers in the area raise livestock such as pigs and cattle.
(這個地區的許多農民飼養豬、牛等家畜。)
The flood killed hundreds of livestock in the village.
(洪水造成村裡數百頭牲畜死亡。)

lizard(n.)蜥蜴
(無詞性變化)
house lizard 壁虎
pet lizard 寵物蜥蜴
A small lizard was resting on the warm rock in the afternoon sun.
(一隻小蜥蜴在午後陽光下的溫暖石頭上休息。)
Some lizards can grow back their tails after losing them.
(有些蜥蜴斷尾後還能再長出來。)

locker(n.)置物櫃、寄物櫃
lock(n./v.)鎖、上鎖
locker room 更衣室
coin locker 投幣式置物櫃
I left my textbook in my locker at school.
(我把課本留在學校的置物櫃裡了。)
The players changed their clothes in the locker room before the game.
(球員們在比賽前於更衣室換衣服。)

lodge(n./v.)小屋、山莊、借住、提出(申訴)
lodging(n.)住宿
mountain lodge 山中小屋
lodge a complaint 提出申訴
We stayed in a cozy mountain lodge during our trip to Alishan.
(我們去阿里山旅行時住在一間舒適的山中小屋。)
Several customers lodged a complaint about the poor service.
(幾位顧客對服務不佳提出了申訴。)

lofty(adj.)崇高的、高聳的、高傲的
loft(n.)閣樓
lofty ideals 崇高的理想
lofty mountains 高聳的山
The young doctor had lofty ideals about helping the poor.
(那位年輕醫生懷抱著幫助窮人的崇高理想。)
Lofty mountains surround the peaceful village.
(高聳的群山環繞著這座寧靜的村莊。)

logo(n.)商標、標誌
(無詞性變化)
company logo 公司標誌
design a logo 設計標誌
The company's logo is a simple blue bird.
(那家公司的標誌是一隻簡單的藍色小鳥。)
Our art club held a contest to design a new school logo.
(我們的美術社舉辦比賽來設計新的校徽。)

lonesome(adj.)寂寞的、孤單的、人跡罕至的
lonely(adj.)寂寞的
feel lonesome 感到寂寞
a lonesome road 一條荒涼的路
She felt lonesome after all her friends moved away.
(朋友們都搬走後，她感到很寂寞。)
The old man walked down the lonesome road at night.
(那位老人在夜裡走在荒涼的路上。)

longevity(n.)長壽、壽命、持久
(無詞性變化)
the secret of longevity 長壽的祕訣
increase longevity 延長壽命
A healthy diet and regular exercise are the keys to longevity.
(健康的飲食和規律的運動是長壽的關鍵。)
Okinawa is famous for the longevity of its people.
(沖繩以居民長壽聞名。)

longitude(n.)經度
longitudinal(adj.)經度的、縱向的
degrees of longitude 經度的度數
line of longitude 經線
Taiwan lies at about 121 degrees east longitude.
(臺灣位於東經約121度。)
Sailors needed accurate clocks to find their longitude at sea.
(水手們需要精準的時鐘才能在海上測出經度。)

lotion(n.)乳液、化妝水、塗劑
(無詞性變化)
body lotion 身體乳液
suntan lotion 防曬乳
Don't forget to put on suntan lotion before going to the beach.
(去海灘之前別忘了擦防曬乳。)
Apply some body lotion after your shower to keep your skin soft.
(洗完澡後擦些身體乳液以保持皮膚柔嫩。)

lottery(n.)樂透、彩券、抽獎、碰運氣的事
(無詞性變化)
win the lottery 中樂透
lottery ticket 彩券
He spends a lot of money on lottery tickets, hoping to get rich overnight.
(他花很多錢買彩券，希望一夜致富。)
Getting a good roommate in college is a bit of a lottery.
(在大學能不能遇到好室友有點靠運氣。)

lotus(n.)蓮花、荷花
(無詞性變化)
lotus pond 荷花池
lotus seeds 蓮子
Every summer, the lotus pond in Baihe is full of pink flowers.
(每年夏天，白河的荷花池都開滿粉紅色的花。)
My grandmother makes a sweet soup with lotus seeds.
(我奶奶會用蓮子煮甜湯。)

loudspeaker(n.)擴音器、揚聲器、喇叭
(無詞性變化)
over the loudspeaker 透過擴音器
portable loudspeaker 攜帶式擴音器
The principal made an announcement over the loudspeaker.
(校長透過擴音器宣布了一則消息。)
A loudspeaker on the truck played music to attract customers.
(卡車上的喇叭播放音樂以吸引顧客。)

lucrative(adj.)賺錢的、有利可圖的
(無詞性變化)
lucrative business 賺錢的生意
lucrative contract 獲利豐厚的合約
Selling Taiwanese drinks abroad has become a lucrative business.
(在國外賣臺灣飲料已成為一門賺錢的生意。)
She turned down a lucrative job offer to work for a charity.
(她拒絕了一份高薪工作，去慈善機構服務。)

lullaby(n.)搖籃曲
(無詞性變化)
sing a lullaby 唱搖籃曲
a gentle lullaby 輕柔的搖籃曲
The mother sang a soft lullaby to put her baby to sleep.
(那位母親唱著輕柔的搖籃曲哄寶寶入睡。)
The sound of the rain was like a lullaby to me.
(雨聲對我來說就像一首搖籃曲。)

lunar(adj.)月亮的、陰曆的
(無詞性變化)
lunar calendar 農曆
lunar eclipse 月蝕
Chinese New Year falls on the first day of the lunar calendar.
(農曆新年在農曆的第一天。)
Many people stayed up late to watch the total lunar eclipse.
(許多人熬夜觀看月全蝕。)

lure(n./v.)誘惑、吸引力、誘餌、引誘
alluring(adj.)誘人的
lure someone into 誘使某人做⋯
the lure of 的誘惑
Online scams often lure victims with promises of easy money.
(網路詐騙常以輕鬆賺錢為誘餌引誘受害者。)
The lure of big city life draws many young people away from their hometowns.
(大城市生活的吸引力使許多年輕人離開家鄉。)

lush(adj.)茂盛的、蒼翠的、豪華的
lushness(n.)茂盛
lush green 綠意盎然的
lush vegetation 茂密的植被
The hills were covered in lush green forests after the rainy season.
(雨季過後，山丘上覆蓋著蒼翠繁茂的森林。)
Hualien is known for its lush valleys and clear rivers.
(花蓮以蒼翠的山谷和清澈的河流聞名。)

madam(n.)女士、夫人(尊稱)
ma'am(n.)女士(madam 的口語縮寫)
Dear Madam 敬啟者(書信用)
Excuse me, ma'am. 不好意思，女士。
Can I help you find anything, madam?
(女士，需要我幫您找什麼嗎？)
Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your wallet.
(不好意思，女士，您的錢包掉了。)

magnify(v.)放大、擴大、誇大
magnification(n.)放大(率)
magnifying glass 放大鏡
magnify the problem 誇大問題
Use a magnifying glass to look at the tiny insects more closely.
(用放大鏡更仔細地觀察這些小昆蟲。)
Social media can magnify small mistakes into big scandals.
(社群媒體可能把小錯誤放大成大醜聞。)

maiden(adj./n.)首次的、未婚的、少女
(無詞性變化)
maiden voyage 處女航
maiden name 婚前姓氏
The Titanic sank on its maiden voyage in 1912.
(鐵達尼號在1912年的處女航中沉沒。)
She kept her maiden name after she got married.
(她婚後保留了婚前的姓氏。)

mainland(n.)大陸、本土
(無詞性變化)
the Chinese mainland 中國大陸
mainland China 中國大陸
Many tourists take ferries from the mainland to the island.
(許多遊客從本土搭渡輪到島上。)
Penghu is about fifty kilometers away from the mainland of Taiwan.
(澎湖距離臺灣本島大約五十公里。)

majestic(adj.)雄偉的、莊嚴的、壯麗的
majesty(n.)雄偉、陛下
majestically(adv.)雄偉地
majestic mountains 雄偉的山脈
majestic view 壯麗的景色
We were amazed by the majestic view of Taroko Gorge.
(太魯閣峽谷的壯麗景色讓我們驚嘆不已。)
A majestic eagle flew high above the valley.
(一隻雄偉的老鷹高飛在山谷上空。)

majesty(n.)雄偉、壯麗、(Majesty)陛下
majestic(adj.)雄偉的、莊嚴的
Your Majesty 陛下(稱呼)
the majesty of nature 大自然的壯麗
The guests bowed and said, 'Good evening, Your Majesty.'
(賓客們鞠躬說：「晚安，陛下。」)
Standing at the top of Jade Mountain, I felt the majesty of nature.
(站在玉山頂上，我感受到大自然的壯麗。)

manuscript(n.)手稿、原稿
(無詞性變化)
original manuscript 原始手稿
submit a manuscript 投稿
The museum displays the original manuscript of the famous poem.
(博物館展出那首名詩的原始手稿。)
The writer submitted her manuscript to three publishers.
(那位作家將她的原稿投給三家出版社。)

maple(n.)楓樹、楓木
(無詞性變化)
maple leaf 楓葉
maple syrup 楓糖漿
The maple leaf is the national symbol of Canada.
(楓葉是加拿大的國家象徵。)
We had pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
(我們早餐吃了淋上楓糖漿的鬆餅。)

mar(v.)損毀、破壞、損害
(無詞性變化)

This road is notorious for its heavy traffic during rush hour.
(這條路以尖峰時段交通壅塞而出名。)
The police finally caught the notorious criminal after years of searching.
(經過多年搜捕，警方終於抓到了那名惡名昭彰的罪犯。)

nourish(v.)滋養、養育、培養、nourishment(n.)營養、養分
nourishing(adj.)有營養的、滋補的
nourish the skin 滋潤肌膚
nourish the mind 滋養心靈
Reading good books can nourish the mind.
(閱讀好書能滋養心靈。)
Plants get nourishment from the soil, water, and sunlight.
(植物從土壤、水和陽光中獲得養分。)

novice(n.)新手、初學者
(無詞性變化)
complete novice 完全的新手
novice driver 新手駕駛
I'm a complete novice at cooking, so please be patient with me.
(我做菜完全是新手，所以請對我有耐心。)
This ski slope is perfect for novices.
(這條滑雪道非常適合初學者。)

nucleus(n.)核心、原子核、細胞核
nuclear(adj.)核子的、原子能的
nuclei(n.)核心、細胞核(複數)
cell nucleus 細胞核
the nucleus of 的核心
The nucleus controls the activities of the cell.
(細胞核控制細胞的活動。)
These five players form the nucleus of the national team.
(這五名球員構成國家隊的核心。)

nude(adj./n.)裸體的、裸體畫、裸體
nudity(n.)裸體
nude painting 裸體畫
in the nude 裸體地
The museum displays several famous nude paintings from the Renaissance.
(博物館展出幾幅文藝復興時期著名的裸體畫。)
The ancient Greek statue shows a nude athlete throwing a discus.
(這座古希臘雕像呈現一名擲鐵餅的裸體運動員。)

nurture(v./n.)養育、培育、培養、教養
(無詞性變化)
nature and nurture 先天與後天
nurture talent 培育人才
Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity and creativity.
(好老師會培養學生的好奇心和創造力。)
Scientists still debate whether personality comes from nature or nurture.
(科學家仍在爭論個性是來自先天還是後天的教養。)
